faqData.question: What is the dress code?
faqData.answer: Guests are invited in light pink and light blue. Choose one as your main color, or combine both in a tasteful mix. We kindly ask that you stay within this palette so the celebration feels cohesive in photos.

faqData.question: May I bring a plus-one?
faqData.answer: Our wedding is intimate. Invitations are addressed to the guests named on the envelope only; plus-ones are not included.

faqData.question: Are children welcome?
faqData.answer: We love your little ones, but this will be an adults-only celebration. Thank you for making childcare arrangements.
